# RealEstateDataCenter.com

> Independent real estate intelligence for the data center economy.

## What this site is

RealEstateDataCenter.com is an independent data center real estate intelligence
publication. It is primarily a blog and market-intelligence resource — not a
consulting firm, brokerage, or sales page. Coverage focuses on the physical
real estate behind the digital economy.

## Who it is for

Institutional investors, developers, appraisers, brokers, landowners,
utilities, lenders, and other market participants who need credible data and
analysis on the data center real estate market.

## Core topics covered

- Data center land and powered land
- Data center site selection and land acquisition
- Zoning, permitting, and entitlement risk
- Power availability, grid access, substations, and transmission
- Farmland conversion to data center use
- Data center land valuation and real estate economics
- Major data center markets (Northern Virginia, Texas, Phoenix, Atlanta,
  Chicago, Ohio, Iowa, Europe)
- Community and regulatory challenges in data center development

## Editorial standing

Independent, factual, and data-driven. Analysis is published for informational
purposes and is not investment, legal, or appraisal advice.

## Business inquiries

Strategic partnerships, sponsorships, content syndication, and business
inquiries are welcome: contact@realestatedatacenter.com
